name: iliadis/brig-api
description: Server-side helpers for BRIG. Server-side PDF uses the File_PDF class (an FPDF-style library, e.g. the PEAR File_PDF package), which is NOT installed via Composer. Install File_PDF with PEAR (pear install File_PDF), upload File/PDF.php, or set pdf.file_pdf_path in the private config. If unavailable, the PDF endpoint falls back to a print-ready HTML page.

suggest.ext-iconv: Recommended: converts UTF-8 text to Latin-1 for File_PDF core fonts.
